name: DataTransfer
comment: 8086 MOV / data-transfer family. 24.6.5 lands incrementally; this initial cut covers MOV r,imm (B0-BF). Later sub-steps fill in MOV r/m forms, segment-register moves, PUSH/POP, XCHG, LEA, LDS/LES.

formats.name: MovR8Imm8
formats.comment: 0xB0-0xB7 MOV r8, imm8 — destination byte register is encoded in the opcode's low 3 bits. 000=AL 001=CL 010=DL 011=BL 100=AH 101=CH 110=DH 111=BH.

formats.name: MovR16Imm16
formats.comment: 0xB8-0xBF MOV r16, imm16 — destination word register is encoded in the opcode's low 3 bits. 000=AX 001=CX 010=DX 011=BX 100=SP 101=BP 110=SI 111=DI.
